1 Tertia pars libri supra laudati p. 94, n. 4.
2 De Zahel, cf. supra p. 92, n. 2. — Eius Liber electionum editus est cum Firmico
Materno a. 1533 et a. 1551 ; cf. Steinschneider, l. c., p. 389 d.
3 ‘Ali ben Ahmed el ‘Imrânî vixit in urbe Mosul, ubi a. 955 obiit. Cuius Liber
electionum a Platone Tiburtino et a Iudaeo Sasavorda versus hodie quoque in
libris mss. exstat, e. g. cod. Paris. 7440, f. 19; cf. Steinschneider, l. c., p. 370, § 25;
Suter, op. cit., p 56, no 119.
4 Pseudo-Ptolemaei Καρπός sive Centiloquium ; novimus versionem Platonis
Tiburtini sed aliam quandam legebat Albertus ; cf. Steinschneider, l. c., p. 383 f.
5 Liber quinquaginta praeceptorum, de quo disserit Steinschneider, p. 389 e, cum
Introductorio Zahelis editus est; cf. supra p. 92, n. 2.
sections.en:
1 Third part of the book praised above p. 94, n. 4.
2 On Zahel, cf. above p. 92, n. 2. — His Book of elections was edited with Firmicus
Maternus in the year 1533 and in the year 1551; cf. Steinschneider, l. c., p. 389 d.
3 ‘Ali ben Ahmed el ‘Imrânî lived in the city of Mosul, where he died in the year 955. Whose Book
of elections translated by Plato of Tivoli and by the Jew Sasavorda today also in
manuscript books exists, e. g. cod. Paris. 7440, f. 19; cf. Steinschneider, l. c., p. 370, § 25;
Suter, op. cit., p 56, no 119.
4 Pseudo-Ptolemy's Fruit or Centiloquium; we know the version of Plato
of Tivoli but Albertus read a certain other one; cf. Steinschneider, l. c., p. 383 f.
5 Book of fifty precepts, concerning which Steinschneider discusses, p. 389 e, with
the Introductory of Zahel was edited; cf. above p. 92, n. 2.

summary.headline: Astrological Elections and Authorities
summary.text: Chapter X surveys astrological elections and their principal authorities, explaining how to select a favorable hour from a known nativity or, when the nativity is unknown, from an interrogation. It cites John of Seville’s Third Part of the Art, Zahel’s and Haly’s books of elections, Ptolemy’s Hundred Words, and Zahel’s Fifty Precepts, with notes on their editions and translations.
